mapper.select: SELECT TRUNC(D.DELIVERY_END_DATE, 'IW') AS PERIOD_START, COUNT(DISTINCT O.ORDER_NO) AS ORDER_COUNT, SUM(OD.PRICE * OD.ORDER_QTY) AS SALES_AMOUNT FROM ORDER_DETAIL OD JOIN ORDERS O ON OD.ORDER_NO = O.ORDER_NO JOIN PRODUCT P ON OD.PRODUCT_NO = P.PRODUCT_NO JOIN DELIVERY D ON D.ORDER_NO = O.ORDER_NO WHERE P.SELLER_NO = #{sellerNo} AND O.ORDER_STATUS = '배송완료' AND D.DELIVERY_END_DATE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY TRUNC(D.DELIVERY_END_DATE, 'IW') ORDER BY PERIOD_START DESC

SELECT O.ORDER_NO, P.PRODUCT_NAME, SUBSTR( CASE WHEN TRIM(PO.OPTION1_VALUE) IS NOT NULL THEN ' / ' || PO.OPTION1_VALUE END || CASE WHEN TRIM(PO.OPTION2_VALUE) IS NOT NULL THEN ' / ' || PO.OPTION2_VALUE END || CASE WHEN TRIM(PO.OPTION3_VALUE) IS NOT NULL THEN ' / ' || PO.OPTION3_VALUE END, 4) AS OPTION_LABEL, OD.ORDER_QTY AS QUANTITY, OD.PRICE, D.DELIVERY_END_DATE FROM ORDER_DETAIL OD JOIN ORDERS O ON OD.ORDER_NO = O.ORDER_NO JOIN PRODUCT P ON OD.PRODUCT_NO = P.PRODUCT_NO JOIN DELIVERY D ON D.ORDER_NO = O.ORDER_NO LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_OPTION PO ON OD.OPTION_ID = PO.OPTION_ID WHERE P.SELLER_NO = #{sellerNo} AND O.ORDER_STATUS = '배송완료' AND TRUNC(D.DELIVERY_END_DATE, 'IW') = #{periodStart} ORDER BY D.DELIVERY_END_DATE, O.ORDER_NO
